observations: Multiple retail boxes for AVINAS Dry Iron.
Model AV-2007 and 1800W rating printed on the front of the boxes.
Boxes are stacked inside a larger shipping carton.
The iron pictured on the box is a classic heavy-duty dry iron style.
No photos of the actual iron outside of the packaging.

claims.evidence: The iron is not shown outside the box to confirm its condition.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, used, or damaged item.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual iron out of the box.

risks.risk: The iron may not function or heat up.
risks.proof: Video of the iron plugged in with the power indicator light on.

risks.risk: The soleplate may be scratched or worn, contradicting the 'new' claim.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the iron's soleplate.

proof_requests: Photo of the iron out of the box showing the soleplate.
Video of the iron plugged in and the indicator light turning on.
Photo of the rating plate on the iron itself to confirm model and wattage.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the packaging, allowing for a valuation at the worst-case condition (used and not working).
